Guidance & outlook: On a consolidated basis, revenue from operations increased to 27.8% year -over-year to INR 2,920 million in Q1 FY27.
The business reported EBITDA of INR 23 million, translating into an EBITDA margin of 20.6%, in line with the management expectation.
The business reported the EBITDA of INR 8 million during Q1 FY27.
Growth & demand: Domestic revenue grew 60.6% year-over-year to INR 251 million, while the export revenue increased to 67.9% to INR 485 million.
Revenue was INR 110 million, representing a 25% substantial increase, while the total sales volume increased to 20.4% subsequently to approximately 1.13 lakh sheets.
Revenue increased 13.1% year-over-year to INR 96 million, supported by 6.9% growth in sales volume.
